name: Initiative Pulse
description:
Initiative Pulse announces initiative Actions, tracks token-turn Effect durations beside token names, and prompts click-to-roll concentration saves after HP damage. No companion scripts are required; Initiative Tracker Plus EOT and optional ScriptCards menus are supported.

Run `!pulse-menu` and select tokens to add Effects. Example: `!pulse effect Haste %% 10 %% ⭐ %% yes`. Actions: `!pulse action Lair Action %% 20 %% yes`. Use `!pulse inspect` to edit/remove Effects and request saves; `!pulse setup` for 2014/2024/custom sheet choices, per-character overrides, concentration advantage, HP bar and markers; `!pulse config` for advanced settings; `!pulse diagnose` to check selected tokens. `!pulse clear` clears combat entries, and `!pulse clean` removes this GM's macros and resets Pulse. Menu macros: `!pulse install-macro`, `!pulse install-clear-macro`, and optional `!pulse install-scriptcards-macro`.

Concentration commands allow token controllers: `!concentration start --token ID --name NAME`, `!concentration stop --token ID`, and `!concentration check --token ID --dc 10`. New concentration replaces the old spell on that token; failed checks or marker removal end the Effect.

Upgrade warning: Effects now require selected tokens and tick at token turn-end, not `!pulse-round`. Old unassigned Effects remain paused until bound through Inspect. Disable separate Manual Concentration and TrackDuration scripts. Defaults use HP bar 1, constitution_save_bonus, warcaster=1, and chained-heart; configure these for your sheet. No caster-to-target links or automatic sorting/turn advancement. See README for complete commands, migration and limits.

D&D 5E (2014) is the default. Optional D&D 5E (2024) support reads constitution_save_bonus through getSheetItem and requires the Experimental API sandbox. Mixed games use explicit per-character sheet choices in Setup. For 2024 characters with War Caster, set concentration advantage to Yes in Setup; feats are not auto-detected. 2024 support and Setup are automated-test verified; live validation is pending.
